chatTheme.$description: The accent colour the account picks in Settings, set as `data-chat-theme` on <html>; every page copy was captured with blue. It paints the user message bubble (`--theme-user-msg-bg` / `-text`, switched on by `data-ds-colored-user-message-bubbles`), the voice and send button (`--theme-submit-btn-*`), text selection, the chart ramp and accent pills. White is `data-chat-theme="black"`, Default is grey bubbles and a black (light) or white (dark) send button.
